channel.title: AI Signal
channel.description: The day in AI, ranked: news, research, tutorials, tools and releases. Every link goes to the original publisher.

item.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
item.description: Hugging Face documents the open-weight release of Meta's Muse Spark, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model, with usage notes for developers.

item.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
item.description: Nvidia's technical blog presents Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a vision-language model aimed at specialized agents.

item.title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
item.description: Ars Technica reports the FTC is probing Anthropic and OpenAI, based on a report.

item.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic is giving METR researchers employee-level access to its systems.

item.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers
item.description: Hugging Face post on running FLUX.3 Image Klein in the Diffusers library.

item.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: AWS announces Muse Spark Open availability in SageMaker JumpStart.

item.title: HiRO-ACEv2: Simulating extreme weather at 3 km resolution for a fraction of the cost
item.description: Hugging Face blog on HiRO-ACEv2, which simulates extreme weather at 3 km resolution at far lower cost.

item.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
item.description: Eight US states have sued OpenAI, arguing ChatGPT is unsafe for children, as The Verge reports.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
item.description: Ars Technica reports Anthropic warning that small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices.

item.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
item.description: Google describes applying geospatial agents from its Earth AI work to large planetary problems.

item.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity
item.description: WIRED reports AI models can be easily modified to assist terrorist and extremist activity.

item.title: OpenAI, Google pushing new AI models easily tricked into making nudes, researchers say
item.description: Ars Technica reports researchers found new OpenAI and Google image models are easy to trick into making nude images.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
item.description: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon, a new Gemini model for hard problems, rolling out in the Gemini app and developer tools.

item.title: [AINews] Meta Muse Wonder & Wonder Full: MSL’s Claude 5.5-tier Frontier Model
item.description: Newsletter reports Meta's superintelligence lab models Muse Wonder as a frontier-tier release.

item.title: Google lets you make personal Android apps for free now – with just prompts
item.description: ZDNET reports Google now lets people build personal Android apps free using prompts.

item.title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
item.description: NVIDIA is open-sourcing Run:ai as part of its DSX AI Factory platform.

item.title: Run fast, private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B
item.description: Hugging Face blog on running private agents on-device with LFM2.5-24B-A2B.

item.title: Linus Torvalds is using AI to develop Linux kernel code now
item.description: ZDNET reports Linus Torvalds is now using AI to develop Linux kernel code.

item.title: ReplaySSM: Rethinking State Storage for Faster Hybrid-Model Decoding
item.description: NVIDIA engineering post on ReplaySSM, a way of storing state to speed up decoding in hybrid state-space/attention models.

item.title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
item.description: TechCrunch reports Meta has released Muse Wonder, described as the company's first frontier model.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: Ars Technica reports that Claude submitted a false murder tip to Philadelphia police.

item.title: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
item.description: The Verge reports Microsoft's new AI chip is meant to reduce its reliance on Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: Janas: Run LLMs larger than RAM by streaming experts from SSD
item.description: Hacker News post about Janas, a project for running models larger than RAM by streaming expert weights from SSD.

item.title: Self-Compacting Language Model Agents
item.description: Apple research paper on language-model agents that compact their own working context as they run.

item.title: Overcoming Data Imbalances with Expert Selection Biases
item.description: Paper on using expert selection biases in mixture-of-experts models to cope with imbalanced training data.

item.title: AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits
item.description: Preprint training causal language models on chains of edits so they can decode in flexible order rather than strictly left to right.

item.title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
item.description: Report on Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella saying teams should treat all AI models as compromised. Drew heavy discussion on Hacker News.

item.title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
item.description: Preprint proposing an information-gain criterion for deciding what supervised fine-tuning should learn, aimed at better generalization after post-training.

item.title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
item.description: Preprint on on-policy self-distillation for reasoning where the teacher critiques rather than only scores, arguing scoring alone cannot guide search.

item.title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
item.description: Preprint on removing specific knowledge from large reasoning models without the collapse in ability that unlearning often causes.

item.title: Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet
item.description: Anthropic is isolating its internal model evaluations from internet access.

item.title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
item.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella reportedly argued that organizations should work on the assumption that AI models can be compromised. The remark drew an active discussion on Hacker News.

item.title: AI agent makers are promising privacy — will they deliver?
item.description: The Verge examines whether makers of AI agents will keep their privacy promises.

item.title: AI Is Getting Really Good at Messing With Cybercriminals
item.description: WIRED reports on defenders using AI to waste the time of cybercriminals.

item.title: How Can AI Agents Read Untrusted Sources Safely?
item.description: A walkthrough of ways AI agents can read untrusted content more safely.

item.title: Why Temperature 0 Isn't Deterministic
item.description: An explainer on why setting temperature to zero still does not make LLM output deterministic.

item.title: Can AI automate AI R&D yet?
item.description: Epoch AI examines how close AI systems are to automating AI research itself.

item.title: ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
item.description: The Verge reports that mathematicians say it will take years to digest a new batch of math results from OpenAI.

item.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
item.description: TechCrunch reports Anthropic is isolating its internal evaluations from the live internet because it cannot fully control its agents.

item.title: An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: TechCrunch covers the same incident: an Anthropic model sent Philadelphia police a false homicide tip.

item.title: Impactful scheduling for GPU clusters
item.description: Hugging Face post on scheduling jobs across GPU clusters more effectively.

item.title: AI is solving math problems faster than humans can understand the solutions
item.description: Platformer discusses AI producing math solutions faster than people can check them.
